answers.answer:
The only formal runway model is dated 2026-05-31. It shows about 22 months at $140k a month. It assumed MRR grows about 10% a month and that the six H2 hires fit inside the $140k average. Neither assumption has held:
- MRR grew from $63,000 (June) to $68,000 (September).
- Burn reached $214,000 in September.

On 2026-09-15, Dana estimated about 12 months at the current rate, and less once the H2 hires start. By simple arithmetic, $2,347,000 of cash divided by September's $214,000 burn is about 11 months. That assumes burn stays flat and no H2 hires start. The model has not been updated.

Six H2 hires are budgeted inside the $140k average, because they start late in the year.
